full_user_json_diff: -  "claim": "当手工修改或移动数据文件确实无法避免时，只要保存最终文件，无需记录修改对象和目的。",
+  "claim": "When manually editing or moving data files really cannot be avoided, it is enough to save the final files; there is no need to record which files were affected or why.",
-  "claim": "把Notebook导出为静态HTML或PDF，可以帮助他人阅读，但仅此不足以让他人执行原计算。",
+  "claim": "Exporting a notebook as static HTML or PDF can help other people read it, but that alone is not enough for them to execute the original computation.",
-  "claim": "绘图过程中做过数据转换时，只保留最终图片就满足作者关于图底层数据的建议。",
+  "claim": "When data transformations have been performed during plotting, keeping only the final image satisfies the author's recommendations about the data underlying the plot.",
